An unforgettable evening at RBar
Oct 2023 • Friends
Having the opportunity to visit RBar, the bar gave me an experience that is hard to find in regular bars. The restaurant space brings a cozy and intimate feeling, very suitable for a date or chatting with friends. The drinks are very diverse and eye-catching. I was introduced to each drink on the Menu in great detail by Dat and felt very impressed with his knowledge and enthusiasm. Dat's friendliness gives me and my friends a feeling of closeness. Although it was just a random visit, Rbar left a very good impression. I will definitely come back to have the opportunity to talk more with this employee.
